What was the best surprise of your trip?

Last year I booked a table at one of the most famous restaurants in Zagreb, three months before the trip. Everybody online said it was such an impressive place. Well, honestly, it did not live up to the reviews. We waited forty minutes for our table, and the room was so noisy that I could not hear my husband. The food was beautiful on the plate, but the portions were so small that we bought a sandwich on the way back to the hotel. The next day we had lunch at a tiny place near the market, with no website and no reviews. The fish was so fresh, and the owner was such a kind man, that we went back twice. That was the real pleasant surprise of the trip.

I am not a big football fan, but in Split a friend took me to see Hajduk at the Poljud stadium. I expected a dull evening. I was wrong. The fans started singing an hour before the game, and the atmosphere was so electric that I forgot to look at the field. The game itself was not impressive. It ended zero to zero. But the people around me were such passionate fans that every pass felt like a final. After the game we walked back along the sea for an hour. It was exhausting, but it was such a good night that I bought a Hajduk scarf the next morning. Now it hangs in my office, next to my books.

First he visited Lake Bled, but the crowd was so big that he could not see the lake. Then a waiter in Ljubljana told him to go west, to the Brda hills near the Italian border. After that he took a long and exhausting bus trip, and he expected a dull little village. At that point a family invited him to taste their wine in a simple room under the house. In the end Brda was such a pleasant surprise that he wants to go back next year.
